methodology.purpose: Evidence-based weekly SEO/AEO opportunity queue using existing dashboard datasets.
principles: No fabricated or interpolated search observations.
Booking starts are not confirmed bookings.
AI referrals do not measure no-click AI answers.
SEO event timing is context, not proof of causation.
GSC query actions are explicitly marked awaiting_post_change_evidence until enough post-2026-10-05 evidence exists.
Low-volume #1-3 rankings are protected from premature CTR optimization.
Business-deprioritized services remain measurable but rank low.

actions.subject: commercial floor maintenance
actions.why_flagged: Commercial cleaning-intent query is within positions 4-20 and has enough current impressions to justify focused optimization.

conversion_context.note: No matching GA4 Organic Search landing-page row was available, so this is sitewide Organic Search context rather than page attribution.

actions.recommended_action: Inspect the ranking page for exact intent coverage, title/snippet alignment, service proof, and relevant internal links. Strengthen the existing page before creating another URL for the same intent.

measurement.30_days: Recheck impressions, clicks, CTR, and average position for commercial floor maintenance. Confirm that Google is still selecting the intended landing page.
measurement.60_days: Compare the next 28-day period with the prior period. Review Organic Search landing-page sessions and booking-start intent without treating a small sample as proof of causation.
measurement.90_days: Evaluate sustained search visibility plus Organic Search booking starts and confirmed bookings. Keep, refine, or reverse the change based on the combined evidence.
